nodes.description: Mapping of account balances; mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Nested mapping of owner=>spender=>allowance; written by _approve and read by transferFrom.
Total token supply; increased in _mint and decreased in _burn.
Immutable-in-practice token name set once in the ERC20 constructor.
Immutable-in-practice token symbol set once in the ERC20 constructor.
Generator version string set in the GeneratorCopyright constructor.
Constant generator URL string returned by generator().
Payable constructor validating initialBalance_ and minting the initial supply to the deployer.
Internal mint: increases _totalSupply and credits _balances, emits Transfer from address(0).
Internal transfer: debits sender balance, credits recipient balance, emits Transfer.
Public transfer entrypoint; forwards caller identity and amount to _transfer.
Public delegated transfer; checks and decrements allowance then calls _transfer.
Internal approval writer for _allowances, emits Approval.
Public approval entrypoint delegating to _approve.
Public helper adding addedValue to the caller's allowance.
Public helper subtracting subtractedValue from the caller's allowance.
Internal burn: debits _balances and _totalSupply, emits Transfer to address(0).
Returns msg.sender; the single trusted source of caller identity in the contract.
View function returning _balances[account].

View function returning _totalSupply.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read inside _msgSender and returned verbatim.
Caller identity from _msgSender becomes the sender of the transfer.
Caller identity from _msgSender becomes the allowance owner in approve.
Caller identity from _msgSender is used as the allowance spender in transferFrom.
Caller identity from _msgSender owns the allowance being increased.
Caller identity from _msgSender owns the allowance being decreased.
transfer delegates the state change to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the balance movement to _transfer.
transferFrom decrements the allowance through _approve.
approve writes the allowance through _approve.
increaseAllowance writes the new allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance writes the reduced allowance through _approve.
_transfer subtracts from the sender balance and adds to the recipient balance in _balances.
_mint adds the minted amount to _balances[account].
_mint increases _totalSupply by the minted amount.
_burn subtracts the burned amount from _balances[account].
_burn decreases _totalSupply by the burned amount.
_approve writes the new allowance into _allowances.
transferFrom reads the current allowance from _allowances.
transferFrom caches the allowance in the currentAllowance local variable.
The decremented currentAllowance is written back through _approve.
decreaseAllowance reads the caller's allowance from _allowances.
decreaseAllowance caches the allowance in currentAllowance.
The reduced allowance is written back through _approve.
increaseAllowance reads and rewrites the allowance entry.
balanceOf reads _balances[account].
allowance reads _allowances[owner][spender].
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
_transfer caches the sender balance in senderBalance before updating state.
Constructor-supplied name_ is stored in _name through ERC20.
Constructor-supplied symbol_ is stored in _symbol through ERC20.
name_ parameter is consumed by the SimpleERC20 constructor.
symbol_ parameter is consumed by the SimpleERC20 constructor.
initialBalance_ parameter is consumed by the SimpleERC20 constructor.
feeReceiver_ parameter is consumed by the SimpleERC20 constructor.
The constructor mints the initial supply via _mint.
The constructor invokes the ServicePayer constructor with feeReceiver_.
The mint recipient is the untrusted deployer address obtained from _msgSender.
ServicePayer constructor performs an external state-changing call to a caller-supplied payable address.
The external pay call can hand control to arbitrary code that may re-enter token entrypoints such as transfer.
User-supplied feeReceiver_ becomes the target of the external pay call.
serviceName parameter is forwarded into the external pay call payload.
recipient argument flows into _transfer.
amount argument flows into _transfer.
sender argument flows into _transfer.
recipient argument flows into _transfer from transferFrom.
amount argument flows into _transfer from transferFrom.
spender argument flows into _approve.
amount argument flows into _approve.
spender argument is consumed by decreaseAllowance.
subtractedValue is consumed by decreaseAllowance.

normalization_plan.reason: Name parameter only exists to feed the constructor's ERC20 base initialization; fold into the constructor node.
Symbol parameter only exists to feed the constructor's ERC20 base initialization; fold into the constructor node.
Initial supply parameter is validated and consumed entirely inside the constructor before minting.
feeReceiver_ is forwarded directly to the ServicePayer constructor and used as the external call target.
Recipient address flows straight into _transfer; no independent semantics.
Amount flows straight into _transfer; no independent semantics.
Debited sender flows into _transfer and the allowance lookup; fold into _transfer.
Credited recipient flows into _transfer; fold into _transfer.
Transferred amount flows into _transfer and the allowance check; fold into _transfer.
Spender flows directly into _approve; no independent semantics.
Allowance value flows directly into _approve; no independent semantics.
serviceName is only used as the payload of the external pay call.
Local cache of the allowance used solely for the transferFrom check and decrement.
Local cache of the sender balance used solely inside _transfer.
Spender is consumed only by decreaseAllowance and its _approve call.
subtractedValue is consumed only by the decreaseAllowance check and subtraction.
Local cache of the allowance used solely inside decreaseAllowance.
